messages:
maria: Quick Q — FinBank is asking for a temporary per-token rate override for a 3-week POC. They estimate ~1.2B tokens; finance is worried about the sticker shock if standard tiering kicks in. Can we do a temporary consumption buffer at a mid-tier rate?

alex: CC @jordan — need cost delta and any precedent. also: do we require a minimum commitment for temporary overrides?

jordan: We did a one-off for RetailCo last year (3-week POC). Deal desk sign-off required. Also, SecQ still open for FinBank.

katie: If they give a short commitment (e.g., $20k) we can set a temporary rate. How long exactly is the POC?

maria: 21 days max. They're okay with a $20k spend floor but want per-token lower during the POC. They also asked for an option to cancel at the end with no auto extensions.

deal-desk: Please submit a formal request with expected tokens, projected spend, and why standard tiering is problematic for the POC. Approvers: @katie and @cooper (finance).

maria: Submitting here: projected tokens 1.2B (expected billable ~1.1B), requested temporary rate $0.000015/token, effective 21 days. Requesting a cap where the override applies up to 1.5B tokens.

jordan: Technical note: they plan to test long contexts which increases KV cache and token churn. Suggest override applies up to 1.5B tokens; any excess billed at the normal tier. Also need SSO + security questionnaire completion before we enable dedicated routing.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire outstanding: FinBank requested SOC2 attestation copy and confirmation on data residency. We have SOC2 and EU regions; SRE to confirm VPC/on-prem options if needed.

katie: Approved in principle. We can do 21-day override at $0.000015/token up to 1.5B tokens with a $20k min. Need a signed email/statement from FinBank and legal review for the terms.

deal-desk: I'll route to legal. @maria, include the POC statement and 'no automatic rollover' clause in the request. Also include the exact billing tag we should use.

maria: Draft email pasted below and I'll attach the SecQ link: https://redwoodintake/sec-q/FINBANK-2026. Draft email: "FinBank agrees to a $20k minimum for the 21-day POC. We request a temporary rate of $0.000015/token for up to 1.5B tokens; no automatic renewal. Please confirm in writing."

alex: :thumbsup: If legal signs off, we can provision a temp rate code and tag usage with finbank_poc_2026. Jordan — can you set routing to prefer Dedicated with Hosted fallback for the POC?

jordan: Yep. Will create route with tag finbank_poc_2026, policy prefer-dedicated, fallback-hosted, KV cache enabled.

deal-desk: Finance requested a simple invoice calc to attach to the approval: 

```
Requested rate: $0.000015/token
Projected tokens: 1.1B -> $16,500
Min commit: $20,000 -> invoice $20,000 upfront
Override cap: 1.5B tokens; any tokens beyond cap billed at standard tier
```

katie: I'll produce the formal calc and a one-pager for legal.

maria: Thanks everyone — standing by for legal + finance. If approved we'll start technical handoff Wednesday and tag resources.
